strategy.summary: Prioritize dispatch quality and deterministic continuation to unlock reliable autonomous throughput.

recommendations.summary: Implement watcher-driven cycle release and redispatch-quality controls before broader runtime features.
recommendations.rationale: This directly reduces non-actionable cycles and improves output per token budget.
recommendations.expected_impact: Lower idle loops and better per-cycle productivity under constrained hardware/rate limits.

recommendations.summary: Expand canary task coverage for runtime coordination path regressions.
recommendations.rationale: Gate failures earlier by linking KPI drift to concrete lane-level recommendations.
recommendations.expected_impact: Faster issue isolation and lower failure amplification across planner/runtime handoffs.

hard: Preserve existing OP behavior unless feature flags explicitly enable new cycle-release mode.
soft: Default to token-conservative mode in low budget environments.

assumptions.statement: Telemetry path naming and ownership remain stable for this planning wave.
Runtime orchestration ownership remains with the same operating team for KPI target rollout.
